name: user-management-system
description: User Management System with Firebase Deployment

scripts.install:all: npm run install:client && npm run install:server
scripts.build:client: node init && cd client && npm run build
scripts.start:client: node init && cd client && npm start
scripts.start:server: node init && cd server && npm start
scripts.start:dev: node init && concurrently "npm run start:client" "npm run start:server"
scripts.deploy: npm run build:client && firebase deploy --only hosting

author: Mr. Beans
